title: `getToolName` doesn't handle hyphens in tool names
body:
https://github.com/vercel/ai/blob/e39ee60dab6cd80110aeff86f5ed770b7e5e98ce/packages/ai/src/ui/ui-messages.ts#L243

This only returns the text between the first and second hyphens, but it should return everything after the first hyphen.

linked_prs.title: fix (ui): support tool names with dash
linked_prs.body:
## Background

Only the fragment after the first hyphen was return as tool name (see #7374 ).

## Summary

Add support for tool names with dashes.

## Related Issues

Fixes #7374

ai_judgment.response:
Yes.  
The issue concerns the parsing logic for tool names, which falls under "Tool implementation errors" in the agent issue taxonomy. It directly affects how agent tools are identified and invoked, making it an agent-specific component.
